en: [to self] Heard that name before.
[Betray Beauty]
Just know his name
Talked to him on the Phone
What if I find one?
Beauty said it was here.
Not at all Bigby, not at all.
Tell me about Jersey.
You're hiding something.
Like what kind of things?
You're saying he kills them.
You won't find one on the floor, that's for sure.
Especially if
This looks like an Axe could fit here.
<from the cashier>Came in and took it, not like I have say over her. I just work here.
I want the truth.
[Punch Him]
Tell me or else!
This is it, this is your last chance.
How can you not know?
I'm confiscating it.
It's sad to see it here.
That is correcta mundo [colloquial].
This dagger Lawrence pawned it?
My fucking axe now!
He's mine first Bigby, I want my axe back!
Consider this a message to the Crooked Man.
A message?
<angry> You're going to fucking die god damn it.
Give me my axe or I'm going to trash this fucking place up!
Jersey my axe shouldn't have been sold. I still have time on my pawn ticket
Maybe their like magical?
He can awnser any questions you might have Bigby.
This is all I need.
Report to the Business Office now!
Yeah probably not.
<suprised> That's not enough!
Yeah like I said there is no axe on the floor.
Are you lying to me?
That's all it is, empty.
Jack you better not be lying to me.  I see an empty case.
Tell me what was in that case, this is your last chance Jack
Just air, it's empty!
Jack where's my axe?
I can say the same thing about you Woody.
And what the fuck happened to your face?
Bigby, thanks, but don't think it's over between us.
And you're still the Woodsman.
Just how I like it.
I don't care how you see me.
She almost killed Bigby with it. [snickers]
[heated] It was right here, in this fucking case, I saw it here.
I have no control over Mary, she took the fucking thing. What do you want me to do about it?
What the fuck? That's going to draw a target on my ass, you fucking asshole.
I want you to call her ass and have her deliver here.
No fuck you [pick a sin/crime] devil.
Oh didn't know that.
[to Bigby whispering]Bigby! Do something!
Fuck you drunk.
[to Bigby whispering] Are you going to do something abou this Bigby?
Watch your attitude.
Where IS his axe?
I've got questions for you.
What the fuck Bigby?
I was here first Bigby, he's mine.
[laughing] Oh shit he's alive.
You need to back off right now Jersey.
And yeah where is my fucking axe?
Jersey, where is that fucking axe?
Guys!
Oka-
I'm looking for the Woodsman's Axe.
There is no axe on the floor, but maybe I can help you with something else?
The axe leads to Bloody Mary that leads to the Crooked Man.
Where is the axe?
Where is Crooked Man?
Give me Bloody Mary!
thanks
I owed you for earlier. No we're even.
Everything here is contraband.
[sighs][c'mon, man] Really?
No, not everything. I don't think the grandmother boosted the train set she dropped off.
[heavy, annoyed sigh]
[I don't want it] It's dirty.
For God's sakes, Jack, it's the girl's bleedin' coat! I didn't steal it, so who on Earth cares?
"Whose gonna care?" Toad, if I take that it's like throwing up the fuckin' Bat-signal to--[Jack notices Bigby]
[not happy] Sheriff....
I swear to the Almighty.
So as soon as I'm done here I'll be off to the witches on the 13th Floor...
Just do me a lemon.
Just do me a favor!
What the Hell does that mean...
Well, it may happen again cause I'm not takin' the coat.
I'm askin' for half what it's worth, you useless...[grumbles angrily]
Keepin' the town honest?
Very honest, I'm sure.
I'm sure very honest.
I didn't steal it... and anyways, everything here is "contraband", that's kinda the point of these--[gets cut off]
Sure it is.
No it's not.
[getting frustrated] Jack, why are you-- I've seen you take a torn purse for a tenner!
Not everything.
She left it in my apartment.
It looks like you slept in it.[beat] In a pile of garbage.
Why are you never glamoured, Toad? Why is it so hard to just follow the rules?
I'm just here for information. It's about the murders. [so don't bullshit me]
Just a bit of business.
Officer...
How's the day treating you?
No, Bigby won't care, it's not like he's--[gets cut off]
This is a surprise.
[deeply annoyed sigh]
[tired greeting] Sheriff.
Yeah, why not?
Look... I know it's tough for a shapeshifter to comprehend this... but it's not so easy for the rest of us to look human, alright?
And anyways, I'm gettin' the money right now.
This'll take two minutes and I'll be out your way.
This'll take just two more seconds and I'll be out of your hair.
Need a decorative lamp? Got plenty of those.
Yeah, but I also got her phone number. I don't want your phone number.
And it'd be covering a check I already wrote.
I'm not taking the coat.
Why would you think I'd take an ugly, used, mule skin coat.
I don't know, but that doesn't mean it'll never happen!
Okay, well... that sounds like a "your problem" problem to me.
When the fuck would I ever want to do that?
[getting annoyed] Yeah, it is! And so I came here to sell it off!
[bored] Oh yeah? What kind?
Cause it's magic mule skin, that's why!
It, uh... suppresses beauty, I think.
Can we, you know, move this along?
So.
But it's magic.
[not paying attention] A horse nun?
[caught of guard; thinking] Uh, you know... one has a, uh, a--a horse mum.
And it's not even mule-skin, it's donkey-skin.
What's the difference.
A horse mum!
I'm tryin' to, but this lousy git can't see a good deal even when it walks in on two little legs.
So what's it gonna be?
This is to pay for those bloody glamours, you know.
I don't know what to tell ya.[beat] See if Cindy needs a coat, I don't know.
I don't set the glamour prices.
This is your own fault.
Snow might help you out.
I wouldn't have to be in here, dealing with this nonsense.
If the witches didn't charge so fuckin' much...
[to Toad]What are you complainin' to him, for?
[venting]I guess I don't know.
[uncaring] Yes, I think the oft-cited statute of "finders keepers" clearly states that it's his now, Bigby.
Hey, wait a minute... that's Faith's coat!
It was Faith's coat.
Look, you left it in my place, what'd you expect me to do?
[angry release]
Come back later, Toad. I have stuff to do.
Wait wait wait, another second, alright?
Making a glamour is hard, and the materials are rare.
The witches set their own prices, Toad, and the prices aren't set because of greed.
Spare me the lesson in hoodoo economics, I don't wanna hear it.
Smashed to a tin can because you had to play rough with the Woodsman!
And what happened to that car? Huh? Let's talk about that!
Give me a break, Toad, this is your own damn fault.
You know... maybe Snow can help you out.
Give you an advance... a loan or something? She's kind of... "in charge" of the Business Office now.
Well the last guy who was "in charge" didn't help us much, so forgive me if I don't expect anything different now.
How could Snow help me out?
Bigby's here.
A loan?[beat] A loan from who.
I don't know what you're gettin' so steamed about...
You know who.
You're talking about the Crooked Man.
These loans aren't worth it.
The loans are why I'm here.
You turn down peoples' stuff so you can peddle his shit?
[getting annoyed] Toad--[gets cut off]
Hey, you got it.
He's never gettin' his hands on me, you understand?
It's just an option, okay?
I mean, what kind of a game are you runnin' here?
But if you don't want it, fine.
An option lots of others have used without a hissy fit.
I know who you're talking about.
The Crooked Man.[beat] Right?[beat] This is his place. Those are his loans.
It's not worth it, Toad.
Yeah, I know it's not worth it.
Funny you should mention that... 'cause it's exactly why I'm here.
You...[quieter] want a loan?
No, I don't want a fuckin' loan.
How does the loan work?
[nervous] You know, um... I'm sorry, Bigby, but... I really shouldn't be talking about this with you.
[nervous] If it gets back to me, you know... I... don't have to tell you I could get in some trouble.
Well then you, Jack, are about to have a very troubling day, because the only reason I came in here was to talk about the Crooked Man.
Well, first, tell me... how does it work.
Yeah.[beat] I do.[beat] So give me one.
[quieter] I didn't really... think you the type...
But this little side operation and all it's bullshit is why I'm here.
That's his sign on the door?[beat] Right?
When has a Crooked Man loan ever been worth it, Jack?
What, sometimes it's worth it? You know, depending.
[cold] High interest isn't servitude.[beat] And nobody's complained before.
He uses fancy boys like Jack here to squelch the honest business man... force him to lay on credit... into servitude.
Who'd listen.
You know this is a fuckin' Crooked Man place, right?
[cold] Good luck with that glamour, Toad.
Well, I'll leave you to your business... I'm sure you'll have a lot to talk about.
How the Hell do you expect me to get a glamour, then?
It's just tough, is all.
To push out the undesirables.
It's not like I've got a lot options, you know.
You have got to be kidding me. That sob story worked on you?
Yeah, just don't be surprised if those weeks turn into months.
[solemn] Keep your money, Sheriff.[beat] I've no patience for charity.
[glum] Do you even know how much a glamour costs?
I've... I've never had to buy one.
I'm... shit, I thought I still had...
Fine. Take it. Get some use out of it.
Just do what I fuckin' say, alright?
And the Business Office squeezin' me the other.
You know, I got the Crooked Man squeezin' me one way...
We're nothing like the Crooked Man.
[Flip him off]
[under his breath] Yeah, fuck you, too.
We're nothing like him.
[under his breath] Whatever you say, Sheriff.
Drop by any time.
You know, it's getting hard to tell the difference...
Between the Business Office and Fables like the Crooked Man.
Between what?
Have a good day.
I'm sorry, alright!
Look, I'm sorry, alright! [to himself]What else do you want from me?
[calling after]Believe me, Toad, you can always go to The Farm.
Came to gloat?[beat] Since you had to go and tell on me, I got eight weeks work-detail from Snow.
I didn't think you were lying.
Look, I work here sometimes for the extra cash. It's something "stable."
I don't care why you work here.
So the last time anybody else saw that axe... it was here.
Bloody Mary works for the Crooked Man, and the last time I saw her, she had the Woodsman's axe.
Is this really why you came down here?
Cause I don't know anything about it.
The Woodsman's axe?
He really grows on ya.
She has me fixing leaky pipes... like I even know what a c-clamp is.
Look, I told you I work here and I do, okay, so don't look so surprised.
I'll be asking the questions here, Jack.
Was the axe here?
Get me the manager.
What about these loans?
[sigh] Okay. Fine.[beat] Fire away.
[sigh] Okay... what do you want to know.
Cause I'm not a mind reader.
Yeah, I'm sure. I'd think I'd notice a giant, mystical axe.
Where's the manager? Why isn't he here?
And unless it's bar trivia, I don't think I can help much, anyway.
'Cause I'm not a mind reader.
I dunno, I don't keep tabs on him. He's probably out getting shit faced and eating cows right now.
Tell me about these loans. How do they work, who collects...?
It's a moonless night, he likes the privacy.
Maybe I'm the manager, you ever think of that?
I know you aren't, so where is he?
No, just... people need money, and the Crooked Man is always willing to help. For a price, you know...
[cold] Really.
Take Beauty and Beast. Beauty needed a few extra bills to make the rent, and so he opened up the coffers and generously provided.
Look, people get desperate... and when you're drowning, anything that isn't sinking along with you looks like a life raft.
The Crooked Man gives, and he wants things in return... and when you don't pay up, bad stuff happens.
Why do you think I've never taken one?
A little credit card fraud never hurt anybody.
But the Crooked Man?
That... and Beauty's loan she took out.
Yeah.[beat] And now you're gonna tell me about it.
She told you about that.
Magic. Memories. Parts of you.[beat] It's bad.
What kind of "things" does he want in return?
Could be anything from... the loan plus interest, family heirlooms to... novelties of a more exotic nature.
Like?
[quieter] At least... that's what I heard.
Or worse. Simple Simon tried to open up a bakery... took out a loan to help with the expense...
"Bad stuff." You mean he kills them.
But when he started gettin' late on the payments... the Crooked Man put him into one of the pies and served it to a litter of alley cats.
That's the real business here, Bigby, not the pawn shop crap.
They check my records. I have to open up so many loans a month or I'm in the shit, too.
Then why'd you try to get Toad to take one!
[angry] Jack...
I have to. It's like a quota!
No way, forget it.
[annoyed] Yeah, it's why I came down here. It will lead me right to the Crooked Man if I can track it.
And that's saying something.
I'm just joking, I never miss anything.
Since, you know, I can sometimes miss the obvious.
And if I just to happen to find a "giant, mystical axe"...?
That would be quite the magic trick.
Got it.
And what if I did mind?
You wouldn't mind if I look around for a bit, then.
I can't Beauty's getting herself this involved.
Neither of us are lying okay... maybe she just saw something like it!
Beauty told me the axe was here.[beat] She told me about a lot of things.
[sheepish] If you know about Beauty, then you know about the loans, right...?
You know... the circumference of a cube, that sort of thing.
Listen, I gotta start closing up shop, so, uh--[gets cut off]
Close? It's the middle of the day.
What can I say, Jersey likes to run at odd hours.
And, really, he'd be the one to talk to, so... can't you just swing by later.
If this is a Crooked Man place, maybe something here will help me find him.
I want to check stuff out here, first.
I don't know. He comes, he goes... he's gone now, I can just call you when he comes back.
What else can you tell me about Jersey Devil?
Maybe the axe is back here.
You better hope not.
It's not.
I'd really rather you not physically be here if he comes back, you know...
He's not what I'd call a... friendly fellow.
In fact he can be a bit rude.
Like... tear out your fingernails rude.
I'm gonna look around...
[casually] Shut up, Jack.[beat] I'm gonna take a look around.
Can't you just--[gets cut off]
